items.statement: The electronic classification is based on a reciprocal-space search or band path capable of locating extrema and Fermi-level crossings, with disclosed method choices.

items.statement: The unstrained intercalated structure is a semiconductor with a finite indirect gap.
Two-percent compressive b-axis strain makes K0.5WTe2 metallic.
Two-percent tensile b-axis strain produces a zero-gap semimetal and near-Fermi unoccupied Te states.
items.expected_result: states[id=tensile_2pct].gap_result.classification is zero_gap_semimetal and orbital_evidence identifies Te or an equivalent supported projection.
